extraction.text:
Shradha Jain

Lead Business Analyst | Product Owner (Proxy) | 9+ Years in Payments and Regulatory Platforms Christyjain30@gmail.com | 8951897626 | Bangalore

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY CSPO and PMP-certified Lead Business Analyst and Product Owner with 9+ years delivering payments and regulatory platforms across global banks. Strong ownership of product backlogs, regulatory-driven prioritization, and Agile delivery across ISO 20022, GPP, and cloud data platforms. Recognized for driving audit- ready releases, reducing delivery risk, and leading cross-functional teams through complex transformations.

CORE SKILLS Product Owner and BA Skills: Product Ownership, Backlog Prioritization, Product Roadmap, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Sprint Planning, Release Sign-off, Stakeholder Management, Requirements Elicitation, Gap Analysis, UAT Domain and Tools: Payments (GPP, ISO 20022, SWIFT MT/MX), Regulatory Reporting, Cloud Data Migration, Jira, Confluence, SQL, Power BI, AWS, Agile, Scrum, Prince2

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Synechron Technologies – Lead Business Analyst, Product Owner (Proxy) Omnia – Data Lake to Cloud Migration Product Ownership and Leadership

Oct 2024 – Dec 2025

Acted as Product Owner proxy, owning and prioritizing the backlog for payments and regulatory data migration. • Took day-to-day prioritization decisions, balancing regulatory deadlines, technical feasibility, and delivery risk. • Led backlog refinement, sprint planning, and sprint reviews as the primary business representative. • Reviewed, validated, and formally accepted stories based on business rules, data accuracy, and compliance criteria. • Provided release sign-off and supported production deployments.

Strategy, Roadmap and Impact

Contributed to quarterly roadmap planning aligned to regulatory milestones and cloud migration phases. • Delivered multiple regulatory and payments datasets with zero critical audit observations. • Reduced rework and reporting defects by approximately 25-30% through improved backlog clarity and acceptance criteria. • Defined and prioritized user stories for ISO 20022 MT to MX datasets, settlement statuses, and reporting logic; partnered with engineering and architecture teams to validate solution design.

Societe Generale – Senior Business Analyst, Product Owner (Proxy) CBR Asia – Regulatory Reporting

Jul 2023 – Oct 2024

Owned the regulatory reporting backlog, prioritizing enhancements and fixes based on regulatory impact and audit findings. • Acted as single point of contact for regulators, auditors, business stakeholders, and delivery teams. • Delivered 15+ regulatory reports across multiple releases with zero critical audit issues; accepted deliverables after validating data lineage, accuracy, and compliance readiness.

Improved reporting accuracy and audit readiness through structured gap analysis; drove prioritization of remediation items based on regulatory trends.

Wipro – Senior Business Analyst Lloyds Bank – MI2B

May 2022 – Jul 2023

Supported Product Owner activities by gathering requirements, defining user stories, and supporting backlog prioritization. • Applied GPP domain expertise to validate payment flows, settlement logic, and ISO 20022 compliance. • Designed and validated BI data models supporting legacy-to-modern platform migration; improved delivery timelines through UAT and requirement clarification.

Accenture, Deutsche Bank, Wells Fargo, Firstsource – Business Analyst

2015 – 2022

Built foundation in payments, investigations, regulatory compliance, and Agile delivery across SWIFT MT/MX, ISO 20022, cross-border payments, settlement, and exception handling.

Supported UAT cycles, defect triage, SQL-based data validation, and production releases across global bank programs.

CERTIFICATIONS PMP (Project Management Professional) | CSPO (Certified Scrum Product Owner) | Prince2 Agile | AWS Certified Data Engineer | Scrum Master Certified | Power BI | SQL

ACHIEVEMENTS

Victory League Award for improving reporting accuracy and reducing audit-related defects. • Rising Star and Quarterly Quality Achiever awards for consistent delivery in regulatory programs.

EDUCATION Bachelor of Commerce (Honours) – Berhampur University, Odisha | 2015
